blocks.text: Life at GACL: Concept of Parivar

blocks.html:
At GACL, we believe our greatest asset is our people. We fondly call our employee family as “GACL Parivaar”. Our team comprises of dedicated professionals from diverse backgrounds, all contributing their unique expertise and passion to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence in the chemical industry.

We are committed to fostering an environment that encourages growth, values, diversity, and empowers our employees to reach their full potential. Our people are at the core of everything we do, driving us towards a brighter, sustainable future.

We have created a workplace culture that celebrates diversity, equity and inclusivity. We foster an environment where all employees, irrespective of gender, feel valued, respected, and heard. We promote open communication and create avenues for feedback and support.

blocks.text: Employee Engagement at GACL – Fostering Unity and Excellence

blocks.html: At GACL, we value our employees as the cornerstone of our success. We recognize that a motivated, engaged, and connected workforce is pivotal to achieving our shared goals. We are dedicated to organizing a spectrum of engaging activities aimed at creating a vibrant and cohesive work culture.

Employee engagement is more than just a phrase at GACL – it’s a fundamental part of our ethos. We strive to provide an environment where our employees feel valued, motivated, and part of a thriving community.

We organize a myriad of events that cater to the diverse interests of our employees. These activities are thoughtfully curated to foster connections, stimulate personal growth, and enhance collaboration across departments.

At GACL we don’t just believe in celebrating moments but also creating memories with our employees. We believe in working with fun and encourage our employees to participate in various group activities organized either by GACL, or our CSR arm; GES.

items.title: Good Samaritan
items.html: Recognized by esteemed bodies like the Society of Human Resource Professionals (SHRP), our commendable efforts during the Pandemic Covid-19 earned us the prestigious "Corona Warrior Award," a testament to our dedication. Additionally, our consistent excellence shines through consecutive victories, securing the 1st Runner-up position at the Outstanding Young Managers Competition by the Baroda Management Association for two consecutive years. Moreover, the Indian Society for Training and Development honoured Mr. Y.K. Shishode, our Senior Manager for Administration and Training, as a distinguished Jury member, recognizing his innovative contributions with the Trainer Award in 2023. These accolades bolster our commitment to excellence and innovation in all endeavours.

items.title: Long Service Award
items.html: At GACL, we believe in more than just fulfilling roles; we're committed to fostering enduring relationships with our team members. We strive to create an environment where individuals find purpose, growth, and a sense of belonging as they contribute to our shared success. We celebrate long term association of our employees every year by organizing Long Service Award.

blocks.html: We firmly believe that engaging in sports activities fosters teamwork, communication, and a sense of camaraderie. Throughout the year we organize various indoor and outdoor sports events and activities which are designed not just for physical fitness but also to encourage collaboration and build strong bonds among our employees, enhancing morale and productivity within the workplace.

In today’s rapidly evolving professional landscape, the empowerment of women at work is not just a matter of equality. From breaking traditional gender roles to championing leadership positions. GACL actively fosters an environment that supports and uplifts women at every level.

Every year we celebrate International Women’s Day with much fervour. On this day we invite all our female employees to share their views and encourage them to meet challenges in their life with utmost valour and braveness and encourage them to participate in various activities. We motivate our women employees and cherish the day by inviting a prominent Women Leader to set an example for them to lead their own path.

Join us in our journey of unwavering principles and transformative growth. Together, we will continue to write success stories, leaving an indelible mark on the chemical industry and the world at large.
